# A named family of atoms (type Opt = int | #none) under else, is and match.
top: type Opt = int | #none;

template: $0 else 0
Opt => error An `else` that does not name its atoms !! L2.5: notyet -- sec:failure "A bare `e else d` ... is rejected in every position"; named-family atoms are data, so `Opt` has no loose atom to list and the repair is the QUESTIONS A67 menu

template: $0 is int
Opt => bool !! L2.5: notyet -- sec:lexical "is type test"

template: match $0 { (is int) -> 1, #none -> 0 }
Opt => 0 | 1 !! L2.5: notyet -- sec:lexical "match value-pattern dispatch"
